senses.gloss:
(इर) रुदिर r. 2nd cl. (रोदिति)
1 To weep.
2 To call or address weeping.
With उप and आङ्,
To weep for another, to sympathize.

f. (रुत्)
1 Grief.
2 Pain, affliction.
3 Disease.
4 Sound, noise.
5 Cry, wail, lamentation.
E.
रुद to weep, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दती-दत्)
Weeping, wailing.
E.
रुद to weep, शतृ aff.

m. (-थः)
1 A dog.
2 A pupil, a scholar.
E.
रुद to weep, अथन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Crying, weeping, wept, (by whom.)
n. (-तं)
Weeping.
E.
रुद to weep, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Surrounded, begirt, as with a fence or river, &c.
2 Secured, protected from access.
3 Obstructed, stopped, shut up.
4 Opposed, stopped, impeded.
5 Besieged, invested, blockaded.
f. (-द्धा)
A siege.
E.
रुध to close, &c., aff. क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being weeping or wailing.
E.
रुद to weep, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-द्रः)
1 A name or form of ŚIVA.
2 A demi-god, an inferior manifestation of ŚIVA, or according to one legend, a being born from the forehead of BRAHMĀ: the RUDRAS are eleven in number, and are severally named, AJAIKAPĀDA, AHIVRADHNA, VIRŪPĀKṢA, SUREŚVARA, JAYANTA, BAHURŪPA, TRYAMBAKA, APARĀJITA, SAVITRA, and HARA.
f. (-द्री)
A sort of lute or guitar.
E.
रुद to weep, रक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel unchanged; the name is given to ŚIVA, because according to his own declaration, he disperses the tears of [] mortals: to the demi-gods, because they wept at their birth, or because they made the enemies of the gods weep.

n. (-जं)
Quicksilver.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, and ज born, being supposed to be the semen of the deity.

f. (-त्नी)
1 Linseed, (Linum.)
2 The goddess DURGĀ.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, and पत्नी wife.

f. (-या)
1 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica)
2 The goddess PĀRVATĪ.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, &c., and प्रिया the beloved.

f. (-भूः)
A cemetery.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, and भू site or haunt.

m. (-लिः)
Oblations of meat, &c. presented to the RUDRAS.
E.
रुद्र a RUDRA, and बलि sacrifice.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of eleven children.
E.
रुद्र a RUDRA, of whom there are eleven, and सू mother.

m. (-डः)
A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, and आक्रीड place of sport; being supposed to dance and sport in such places at evening twilight.

m. (-क्षः)
A tree, (Eleocarpus ganitrus, Rox.)
n. (-क्षं)
The berry of the Eleocarpus, of which rosaries are usually made.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, and अक्ष from अक्षि the eye.

f. (-णी)
The goddess DURGĀ, as the wife of RUDRA or ŚIVA.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.

n. (-सः)
Benares.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, and आवास abode.

m. (-रिः)
KĀMA, the deity of love.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, and अरि enemy.
